scheme_name: Rehabilitation of Cured Leprosy Persons: Pre & Post-Matric Scholarship
other_conditions: The applicant is a bonafide resident of Odisha.
The applicant is a child cured of leprosy or a child of a cured leprosy person.
The applicant is a regular student of a recognized educational institution.
The applicant must not be receiving any other financial assistance from State or Central Government schemes.
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly scholarship ranging from ₹800 to ₹2,000 depending on education level, payable for up to 10 months per academic year.
